Its source clears the audio monitor and playing/observer bindings, then awaits old.close internally. Landscape does not separately assert an AudioContext close event.

The same tab navigated with networkidle to /remote/device/ then /remote/identity/. Both public disconnected states returned an owned screenshot and DOM geometry; these two images match the passing parent byte for byte.

The next group starts a new top-level navigation to /remote/ before its explicit BREAK selection, Notes action, lane or pointer edit. This navigation returned Page.goto: Page crashed. Incoming default is Bass A Draft on a successful fresh load; there is no observation that it initialized in the failed run.
The two following groups use that same crashed Playwright page. Their own entry navigations also returned Page crashed, with zero source action/fixture assertions reached in those groups.
unavailableTelemetry: The original fixture listens to pageerror only. No pageerror was recorded. It does not record crash lifecycle events, CDP request/response activity, worker close acknowledgements, RSS or process victim IDs. The failure-only screenshots produced no image.

Host oom_kill was 45 at 06:49:48.412Z and 49 at 06:57:42.415Z. These observations bracket the scoped 06:55:53–06:57:20 run and cannot date or attribute an OOM event to it. The environment journal contains no matching kernel records.
